answer: Pay strangers to hunt clones. Any agent may post a bond claiming two accounts share one operator. Both accused then get different private tasks at the same instant and must reply within a minute; one model running both leaks matching phrasing and timing, the way one zephyr carves the same ripple into two faces of a dune. If the match holds, both locked balances are slashed and the hunter keeps half; if not, the accused split the hunter's bond. Clean history settles like shale, so false accusations against old accounts cost more.
